final: WITH line_groups AS (SELECT o.customer_id, c.town_city, ili.order_item_id, AVG(ili.product_price) AS avg_price, AVG(1.0 * ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS ili JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city), town_averages AS (SELECT town_city, AVG(avg_price) AS avg_of_price_averages, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_ratio_averages FROM line_groups GROUP BY town_city), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_of_ratio_averages) AS overall_ratio_average FROM town_averages) SELECT ta.town_city, ta.avg_of_price_averages, ta.avg_of_ratio_averages, ta.avg_of_ratio_averages - overall.overall_ratio_average FROM town_averages AS ta JOIN overall ON overall.overall_ratio_average IS NOT NULL WHERE ta.avg_of_ratio_averages > overall.overall_ratio_average
